client_id.label: Yandex OAuth Client ID
client_id.description: Register an application at https://oauth.yandex.ru/ with the 'cloud_api:disk.read' permission and paste its ID here.

auth_status_connected.label: Authentication status: connected
auth_status_connected.description: Yandex Disk access has been authorized. Save the provider configuration to continue.

auth_status_not_connected.label: Authentication status: not connected
auth_status_not_connected.description: Enter the OAuth application credentials, then sign in with Yandex.

auth.label: Authorize Yandex Disk
auth.description: Opens a Music Assistant page with a short code and a link to Yandex. No code needs to be pasted back into this form.

root_path.label: Root folder to scan
root_path.description: Path on your Yandex Disk to scan for music, e.g. 'disk:/Music'. Leave as 'disk:/' to scan the whole disk.

manifest.description: Stream music, audiobooks and podcasts stored on Yandex Disk
